purpose: decision-support triage list; not a prediction of individual pages

playbook.evidence (capstone, within-client tiers): share of loss halves without the top client

review_rules.rule: open the page and check it is not already being rewritten or recovering
check the impressions come from relevant queries, not a few odd ones
check the decline is not a seasonal dip seen in the same month last year
rewriting, publishing or deleting a page from a score alone
telling a client a page 'will' decline or that a refresh 'will' lift traffic
using reason codes as proof of cause

monitoring_triggers.trigger: per-client AUC of the rule falls below 0.5 in 3 or more of 10 clients
monitoring_triggers.response: stop using the rule for ranking

monitoring_triggers.trigger: top 20% of pages finds under 40% of lost impressions (now 50.9% for the rule)
a new snapshot or a dated warehouse release becomes available
monitoring_triggers.response: rebuild features and re-run the comparison

monitoring_triggers.trigger: one client holds over 50% of lost impressions (now 46.9%)
